Search the variables described by a study

Source: R/surveys.R
knbs_variables.Rd

Returns variable metadata only. No microdata are downloaded, and none can be: the package does not fetch gated files.

Usage

knbs_variables(
  survey,
  search = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  concept = NULL,
  limit = Inf,
  details = FALSE,
  source = NULL,
  cache = knbs_option("cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

survey

A study identifier, or enough of its title to identify it.

search

Free text matched against variable names and labels.

file

Keep only variables from this file, by file id or file name.

name

Exact variable name.

concept

Keep only variables with this concept. Requires details = TRUE, since concepts are only in the per-variable records.

limit

Maximum number of variables to return.

details

Whether to retrieve the full record for each variable. This costs one request per variable, so it is capped at 100 rows.

source

Source id.

cache

Whether to use the local cache.

refresh

Whether to bypass any cached response.

Value

A tibble of variable metadata. A study catalogued without variable documentation returns zero rows, which is a normal answer rather than an error.

Details

Question text, universe, concept and value labels each require one request per variable, so they are NA unless details = TRUE.

See also

knbs_survey_files(), knbs_survey_metadata()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
knbs_variables("KEN-KNBS-KIHBS-2015-2016-v01", search = "consumption")
}
